To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the development of pH microenvironments by photosynthesizing algae is size dependent, with cells smaller than 20 μM (length or width) producing no detectable microenvironments, and larger cells producing them, and that the size dependence is a result of the ratio of the rate of CO2 uptake and the rate of CO 2 diffusion from the cell to the surrounding medium.
